## Verified Engineering Case Studies

### 1. RecoverFlow AI — Autonomous AI Agent OS
- **Domain**: Autonomous AI Workflow Orchestration & Checkpoint State Recovery
- **Stack**: Next.js 15, Node.js, Prisma ORM, TypeScript, AI Agents, Vercel
- **Problem**: Multi-agent autonomous workflows frequently experience catastrophic state loss, uncontrolled loops, and tool-call crashes without structured checkpoint recovery.
- **Solution & Architecture**: Engineered a deterministic checkpoint state recovery engine with sandboxed tool execution pipelines and real-time execution trace telemetry.
- **Repository**: https://github.com/skmdshariff143-ai/recoverflow-ai
- **Live Demo**: https://recoverflow-ai.vercel.app

### 2. NeuroLearn AI — Multi-Provider Pedagogical Learning Platform
- **Domain**: Pedagogical Curriculum Generation & Diagnostic Multi-LLM Router
- **Stack**: Next.js 15, React 19, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Nebius, NVIDIA Nemotron, Gemini API, Groq, Playwright
- **Problem**: Superficial one-shot LLM summaries risk hallucinations and lack pedagogical reteaching loops or student data privacy.
- **Solution & Architecture**: Built a universal Research-to-Teaching coordinator with SSRF-safe multi-source academic querying (OpenAlex, Wikipedia, Crossref, OpenStax), deterministic grading, and local-first browser storage with zero learner tracking.
- **Verification**: Complete automated test suites passing across 10 canonical benchmark topics.
- **Repository**: https://github.com/skmdshariff143-ai/neurolearn-ai
- **Live Demo**: https://neurolearn-ai-pink.vercel.app

### 3. Amazon ML Challenge 2026 — Entity Resolution Pipeline
- **Domain**: High-Throughput Scalable Machine Learning & Merchant Entity Deduplication
- **Stack**: Python 3.13, LightGBM, RapidFuzz, PyArrow, NumPy, Pandas, Pytest
- **Problem**: Resolving identity across 1.7M+ noisy merchant records with partial attributes, name typos, and extreme class imbalance without heavy pretrained embeddings.
- **Solution & Architecture**: Developed a token-frequency inverted index candidate generator (207M+ candidate links) coupled with a 19-feature hard-negative LightGBM classifier.
- **Demonstrated Result**: 0.8879 Macro F0.5 (0.9563 Precision) on local 5,000-anchor calibration holdout; 39 automated unit and streaming validation tests passing.
- **Repository**: https://github.com/skmdshariff143-ai/amazon-ml-2026-entity-resolution

### 4. CreditGuard AI — Credit Card Approval Risk Prediction
- **Domain**: Machine Learning Credit Delinquency Prediction & MLOps
- **Stack**: Python, Scikit-Learn, XGBoost, Flask, Docker, GitHub Actions CI/CD
- **Problem**: High credit delinquency default rates caused by inaccurate credit risk scoring and severe data imbalance.
- **Solution & Architecture**: Developed custom data preprocessing pipelines with SMOTE oversampling and an XGBoost classification engine with interactive Flask dashboard.
- **Demonstrated Result**: 66.67% delinquency recall on imbalanced credit applicant test sets with automated CI/CD pipeline.
- **Repository**: https://github.com/skmdshariff143-ai/Credit-Card-Approval-Prediction
- **Live Demo**: https://creditguard-ai.vercel.app

### 5. FarmaLink-AI — Direct Agricultural Marketplace SaaS
- **Domain**: Full-Stack Agricultural Marketplace & Escrow Transactions
- **Stack**: Next.js 15, React 19, TypeScript, Prisma, Supabase, Vercel
- **Problem**: Agricultural supply chain exploitation by intermediaries, opaque pricing, and lack of crop disease diagnostics.
- **Solution & Architecture**: Built direct farmer-to-buyer platform with AI disease diagnostic tooling and simulated escrow payment workflows.
- **Repository**: https://github.com/skmdshariff143-ai/farmlink-ai
- **Live Demo**: https://farmlink-umber.vercel.app
